title: kithctl backup: progress output missing on Done — eprintln after loop leaves no final-page progress printed
description: backup.rs backup_progress is called only in the More arm (line 94). On StepResult::Done, the disarm and break happen without calling backup_progress — the final page batch is silently skipped. For small databases (fewer than PAGES_PER_STEP=100 pages), the loop may complete with a single Done step and no progress output at all, leaving the operator staring at a blank stderr. The eprintln() on line 109 prints a newline to clear the progress line, but if no progress was ever printed, it outputs a spurious blank line.
